'''Raamen''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

==History==
It was believed that [[Granta Omega]] fled to Raamen after his defeat on [[Mawan/Legends|Mawan]].<ref name="Omega">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030612omega|text=Granta Omega: An Expanded Universe Character}}</ref>
